function.name: sulcus_remember
function.description: Store a memory in Sulcus. Call this whenever the user shares something that should be remembered across conversations: facts, preferences, decisions, procedures, or events. Choose memory_type to categorize it correctly: 'semantic' for facts/knowledge, 'episodic' for events/history, 'preference' for user preferences, 'procedural' for how-to instructions. Higher heat (0–100) makes the memory more prominent in future context.

content.description: The text content to store as a memory. Should be a clear, self-contained statement (not raw conversation JSON).

memory_type.description: Category of memory. 'semantic' = facts/knowledge, 'episodic' = events/history, 'preference' = user preferences, 'procedural' = step-by-step instructions.

heat.description: Initial activation heat (0.0–100.0). Higher heat makes this memory surface more often. Default: 80.0.

namespace.description: Optional Fold (memory namespace) to scope this memory to — e.g. 'project-alpha', 'client-acme'. Omit to store in the default namespace.

function.name: sulcus_search
function.description: Search memories in Sulcus using hybrid semantic + full-text search. Call this before answering any question that may involve past context, user preferences, project state, or known facts. Returns the most relevant memory nodes ranked by similarity.

query.description: Natural language query describing what you're looking for in memory.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return. Default: 10.

memory_type.description: Filter results to a specific memory type. Omit to search across all types.

function.name: sulcus_list
function.description: List memories in Sulcus with optional filters. Use this to browse memories by type, namespace, or pinned status — for example to audit what's stored, or to build a memory inventory. Supports pagination.

page_size.description: Number of results per page. Default: 20.

memory_type.description: Filter by memory type. Omit to return all types.

namespace.description: Filter by Fold (memory namespace). Omit to return memories from all namespaces.

pinned.description: If true, return only pinned memories. If false, return only unpinned. Omit to return both.

function.name: sulcus_forget
function.description: Permanently delete a memory from Sulcus by its ID. This is irreversible — the memory node, its edges, and its payload are all removed. Only call this when the user explicitly asks to forget or delete something. Prefer sulcus_update to correct a memory instead.

memory_id.description: The UUID of the memory node to permanently delete. Obtain this from sulcus_search or sulcus_list results.

function.name: sulcus_update
function.description: Update fields on an existing Sulcus memory node. Use this to correct a stored fact, rename a memory, change its type, pin/unpin it, or adjust its heat. More surgical than forget+re-remember because it preserves the node's history and edges.

memory_id.description: The UUID of the memory node to update. Obtain this from sulcus_search or sulcus_list results.

label.description: New short display label for this memory.

is_pinned.description: Set to true to pin this memory (prevent decay). Set to false to unpin and allow normal thermodynamic decay.

heat.description: New activation heat value (0.0–100.0). Raise heat to make a memory surface more prominently.
